name: cytochrome P450 family 7 subfamily B member 1

function.text: CYP7B1 is the approved symbol for cytochrome P450 family 7 subfamily B member 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in 24S-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity; 25-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity; B cell chemotaxis.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include CYP7B1-related disorder of oxysterol accumulation (autosomal recessive); congenital bile acid synthesis defect 3 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: CYP7B1 encodes cytochrome P450 family 7 subfamily B member 1. Its functions include 24S-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity and 25-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include CYP7B1-related disorder of oxysterol accumulation (autosomal recessive); congenital bile acid synthesis defect 3 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYP7B1 have been reported in gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
